visual_checks.all: Inspected all three contact sheets and the dressed street mock against Board2 and approved storefronts. Original textured sprites; directly frontal/slightly above; bright warm midday; no game-atlas text/grid; all key backgrounds flat.
visual_checks.fences: Diagonal wire diamonds and gate braces are real construction detail, not camera recession. Corner returns are narrow north-going cap/rail bands, exactly screen-vertical.

limitations: Padded fence cells require connector placement stride208px with16px overlap, not a256px TileMap stride. This reconciles no cell-edge contact with seamless joined sections.
Only one NE/north-return corner orientation per fence family is included, as the Sheet asks; no unrequested complete wall autotile set.
Edge-on corner returns are deliberately narrow and less immediately readable than diagonal/isometric corners.
The ash reads as a sparse, slightly drooping urban tree; species identity is stylized.
Fine library books, flag emblem, cart wire and scattered leaves compress at64px cells.
Mock fence sprites displayed at quarter native size; trees/clutter native, with two shrubs at half size. Preview is not engine placement/collision verification.
